aion_mlp.assumed: Adam lr 1e-3, batch 256, fixed epochs with best-validation-loss selection; standardized features; our 80/10/10 split (AION uses 80/20 with no validation set); our eval set is Galaxy10 DECaLS, not AION's GZ10 x Legacy Survey DR10 cross-match (~8k galaxies)
aion_mlp.from_paper: AION-1 (arXiv:2510.17960): 'two-layer MLP head (hidden size = 256, GELU, dropout = 0.1)' on frozen mean-pooled embeddings; class-stratified split

astroclip_mlp.architecture: Linear(dim, 256) -> Dropout(0.2) -> ReLU, x3, -> Linear(256, 10), softmax inside forward
astroclip_mlp.assumed: applied to hard Galaxy10 labels instead of GZD-5 debiased soft labels; our 80/10/10 split; epochs with best-validation-loss selection
astroclip_mlp.from_paper: AstroCLIP morphology MLP as reimplemented in Evals/gzd5_morphology_probe/train_gzd5_mlp.py (hidden 256, dropout 0.2, Adam 1e-3, batch 256)
astroclip_mlp.loss: CrossEntropyLoss applied to softmax outputs, matching AstroCLIP code
